doc.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023

title: Her mother's support and her father's objection to music school
summary: Her mother, not her father, encouraged her to go to the University of Miami.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did your mother, when you decided to go to music school, University of Miami was it?
With obviously if you’re going to make that commitment you’re saying that I’m going to make a career and I’m going to need to get paid. Did she object to that?

No. Not at all. My father did. It was my father, not my mother. It is my mother who’s responsible for this beautiful experience I had in life and having seen the world. And without her encouragement and without her creating and finding every possible way to make this happen I wouldn’t be talking to you.
